evidence: Repeated synthetic-note append/prepend assays retained all prior substantive content and unique inserted markers on independent read_note readback. read_note intentionally exposes normalized plain text rather than raw stored HTML, so the connector contract's stronger byte-for-byte structure-preservation claim is not independently testable from this surface.
falsifier: Obtain a raw stored representation before and after additive mutation and show any pre-existing byte differs, or demonstrate loss/reordering of pre-existing semantic content on independent readback.
authorityBoundary: Synthetic internal note only; no external recipient or send effect.
